name: Cell compactness
sentence: How far a cell's outline can stray from a round shape. Low: it stays closer to round. High: it can stretch out to follow its RNA.
info: Made-up cells, started from cells only: this cell's own RNA runs out in a thin arm of 157 transcripts. Other settings at proseg's defaults. Each panel: the middle of 27 copies run in proseg 3.2.0. At 0.08 the edges fray while proseg refines; final settling smooths most of it. On real 500 µm squares, 0.02 and 0.08 instead of 0.04 made proseg's count of the cells about 9 % lower and 10 % higher.
statTip: Of the arm's 157 transcripts, those this cell's count keeps.
